output.title: Distressed Analog Photocopy Text with Heavy Grain

prompts.prompt: Create a distressed photocopy-style text preset that simulates the harsh, degraded look of repeatedly photocopied documents. From a video editor's perspective, think of this as layering multiple text duplicates with slight offsets and varying opacities - like stacking degraded photocopies. The main text should have a harsh black-and-white contrast with blown-out edges. Add a subtle shake effect that feels like the mechanical vibration of an old copy machine (2-3px amplitude, irregular rhythm). Implement heavy grain using CSS filters combining noise texture overlays with contrast adjustments. The text should animate in with a 'scan line' effect - revealing from top to bottom as if being photocopied in real-time. Each word should have slight registration errors (1-2px random offsets) to simulate paper misalignment. Use TextAtom components with multiple layers for the distressed effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden bg-white' containing multiple TextAtom layers. Main text layer uses 'absolute inset-0 mix-blend-multiply' with filter effects. Create 3-4 duplicate text layers with 'absolute opacity-20' and transform offsets (translateX/Y 1-2px). Apply CSS filters: contrast(200%) brightness(1.2) blur(0.3px) for harsh photocopy look. Add grain overlay div with 'absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-30' using CSS background-image noise pattern. Implement shake using generic effects with translateX/Y animations (range: -3 to 3px, duration: 0.1-0.2s loops). Scan reveal uses clip-path animation from polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 0%, 0 0%) to full reveal over 0.8s with ease-out. Each word gets random transform via internal effect preset with slight rotate(-1 to 1deg) and translate variations. Performance: use will-change: transform, filter on animated elements. Consider using sub-preset for reusable photocopy grain effect.

prompts.prompt: Design an analog VHS tracking error text effect that captures the unstable, jittery quality of damaged videotape. As a video editor, envision this as horizontal displacement glitches that affect different parts of the text independently - like when VHS tracking is misaligned. The text should constantly shift horizontally with varying intensities across different vertical bands. Add chromatic aberration by splitting RGB channels with slight offsets. Include periodic 'tracking lines' - horizontal bands of distortion that travel vertically through the text. The shake should be more aggressive than typical text animation (5-10px horizontal displacement) with sudden jumps rather than smooth movements. Typography should use a blocky, mono-spaced font reminiscent of old CRT displays. Implement scan lines and subtle color bleeding for authenticity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden'. Use TextAtom with monospace font 'font-mono text-white text-6xl'. Create RGB channel split using 3 TextAtom layers: red channel 'absolute text-red-500 mix-blend-screen', blue 'absolute text-blue-500 mix-blend-screen translate-x-1', green 'absolute text-green-500 mix-blend-screen -translate-x-1'. Implement horizontal displacement using generic effects on each text segment (split text into 3-4 horizontal bands using multiple BaseLayouts with clip-path). Each band animates translateX with different ranges (-10px to 10px) and timings (0.05-0.15s intervals). Add scan lines overlay: BaseLayout with repeating linear-gradient 'bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-white/5 to-transparent bg-[length:100%_4px]'. Tracking lines: animated div with 'absolute left-0 right-0 h-8 bg-white/10' using translateY animation from -100% to calc(100vh + 100%). Use waveform effects for audio-reactive glitch intensity if audio is present. Performance: GPU accelerate with transform3d, limit to 60fps animations.

prompts.prompt: Develop a xerox degradation text effect that mimics the progressive quality loss of multi-generation photocopies. Picture this in your editing timeline as a text element that starts clean but progressively degrades - like making a copy of a copy repeatedly. Begin with sharp text that gradually accumulates artifacts: increasing contrast until whites blow out and blacks crush, progressive edge bleeding, accumulating dust spots and scratches, and increasing geometric distortion. The shake should start subtle and intensify over time, suggesting the mechanical wear of an aging copier. Add intermittent 'paper jam' glitches where the text briefly stretches horizontally before snapping back. Include toner streak artifacts - vertical bands of varying darkness. The animation should feel mechanical rather than digital, with stepped rather than smooth transitions.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-100'. Main TextAtom starts clean, then applies progressive filter degradation via generic effects. Initial state: 'text-black text-5xl font-bold'. Degradation timeline using AnimationRange: 0-30% contrast increases (100% to 300%), 30-60% add blur (0 to 1px) and brightness variations, 60-100% extreme contrast with filter: contrast(500%) brightness(0.8) blur(1.5px). Create dust/scratch overlay using multiple small divs positioned absolutely with 'w-1 h-1 bg-black rounded-full opacity-40' at random positions. Paper jam effect: internal effect preset that animates scaleX from 1 to 3 to 1 over 0.3s with spring easing. Toner streaks: vertical divs with 'absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-4 bg-black/20' with varying opacity. Progressive shake using generic effects: translateX/Y starting at ±1px, ending at ±5px. Add stepped transitions using steps(4) timing function for mechanical feel. Use fitDurationTo: 'self' with minimum 3s duration for full degradation cycle.

prompts.prompt: Create a risograph print registration error text effect that captures the charming imperfection of riso printing. From an editor's viewpoint, imagine overlapping color separations that don't quite align - each color layer slightly offset, creating beautiful accidents. The text should be composed of 2-3 color layers (like cyan and magenta in riso printing) with intentional misregistration. Add a characteristic riso grain texture - coarser than digital noise. The shake should be minimal but constant, suggesting the mechanical vibration of the drum printer. Include subtle color bleeding at edges where layers overlap. Implement halftone dot patterns for that authentic riso aesthetic. The animation should reveal each color layer sequentially, as if printing one color at a time, with slight position drift between each pass.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container 'relative w-full h-full bg-yellow-50'. Create 3 TextAtom layers for color separations: Layer 1 'absolute text-cyan-500 mix-blend-multiply translate-x-0.5 -translate-y-0.5', Layer 2 'absolute text-pink-500 mix-blend-multiply -translate-x-0.5 translate-y-0.5', Layer 3 'absolute text-purple-600 mix-blend-multiply opacity-80'. Each layer animates in sequentially with 0.3s delays using opacity effects (0 to 1 over 0.5s). Add halftone pattern overlay: div with CSS background using radial-gradient for dot pattern 'bg-[radial-gradient(circle,_black_1px,_transparent_1px)] bg-[size:4px_4px] opacity-10'. Grain texture: overlay div with noise filter 'filter: url(#noiseFilter)' or CSS grain pattern. Minimal shake via generic effects: translateX ±1px, translateY ±0.5px with 0.2s duration loops. Color bleeding: add filter: blur(0.5px) to each text layer. Registration drift: animate each layer's transform slightly over time (±2px range over 3-4s). Use sub-preset for reusable halftone overlay effect.

prompts.prompt: Design a mimeograph machine text effect with the distinctive purple-ink aesthetic and chemical smell of spirit duplicators. Think of this as text that appears wet and slightly smeared, with the characteristic purple-blue ink color of mimeograph prints. The text should have uneven ink density - darker in some areas, faded in others, suggesting inconsistent ink distribution on the drum. Add subtle ink bleeding around edges, especially on curves and corners. Include random ink spots and smudges that appear before and after the text. The shake should be rhythmic and mechanical - matching the rotation of the duplicator drum (steady 2-3 Hz oscillation). Implement a 'wet ink' shine effect that gradually dries/fades. Text should animate in with a rolling reveal, as if printed by a rotating drum.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-50'. TextAtom with distinctive purple color 'text-purple-800 opacity-90 font-serif text-5xl'. Create ink density variation using multiple shadow layers: text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(purple, 0.4), 1px 1px 3px rgba(purple, 0.2). Add wet ink shine using ::before pseudo-element (via style prop) with linear-gradient overlay animating opacity from 0.3 to 0 over 2s. Ink bleeding: filter: blur(0.8px) with increased blur on animation. Random ink spots: absolute positioned divs 'w-2 h-2 bg-purple-800/30 rounded-full blur-sm' scattered randomly, appearing with staggered delays. Mechanical shake using generic effects with sine-wave pattern: translateY animation using Math.sin for smooth oscillation (2-3px amplitude, 0.5s period). Rolling reveal: clip-path animation from circle(0% at 50% 50%) to circle(150% at 50% 50%) over 1s. Ink smudges: elongated divs with 'bg-purple-800/20 blur-md skew-x-12' positioned near text edges. Add subtle texture overlay with 'bg-[url(paper-texture)] mix-blend-multiply opacity-20'.

prompts.prompt: Develop a thermal fax paper text effect that captures the unique qualities of heat-sensitive paper printing. Visualize this as text that appears to be burned onto thermal paper - with the characteristic dark gray color and slight fade that occurs over time. The text should have crispy, slightly pixelated edges from the thermal print head dots. Add horizontal banding artifacts from uneven heat distribution. Include paper curl distortion at the edges, suggesting the way thermal paper curls when heated. The shake should be minimal but include occasional 'print head skip' glitches where lines briefly disappear. Implement a gradual fade effect suggesting thermal paper degradation over time. Add subtle yellow-brown discoloration around text edges for aged thermal paper look.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-100 to-gray-200'. TextAtom with thermal print color 'text-gray-800 font-mono tracking-wider'. Pixelated edges using CSS: image-rendering: pixelated with slight scale(1.01) for crispiness. Horizontal banding: multiple thin divs 'absolute left-0 right-0 h-px bg-black/10' spaced every 8-10px. Paper curl distortion: apply perspective transform with rotateX(2deg) to container, add subtle skew at edges using clip-path. Print head skip glitch: internal effect preset that sets opacity to 0 for 50ms every 2-3s randomly. Thermal degradation: generic effect animating color from rgb(40,40,40) to rgb(80,80,80) over component duration. Edge discoloration: use box-shadow with brown tints 'shadow-[inset_0_0_10px_rgba(139,69,19,0.1)]'. Add dotted texture using repeating linear gradient for thermal dot matrix feel. Minimal shake: translateY ±0.5px with occasional 1-2px jumps. Performance: use CSS containment for layout optimization.

prompts.prompt: Create a brutal concrete poetry text effect inspired by 1960s brutalist graphic design and degraded photostat reproductions. Picture heavy, bold text that's been photocopied so many times it's become abstract - edges are completely blown out, creating dramatic black shapes. The shake should feel heavy and industrial - like machinery vibrating through concrete (low frequency, high amplitude). Add extreme contrast with no mid-tones - pure black and white only. Include registration marks and crop marks as design elements that also shake and distort. Implement torn paper edges and scotch tape artifacts suggesting DIY zine aesthetics. The text should slam in aggressively - no subtle fades, just immediate impact with a brief overshoot bounce.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-white overflow-visible'. TextAtom with extreme weight 'text-black font-black text-7xl uppercase tracking-tighter'. Apply harsh threshold filter: filter: contrast(1000%) brightness(1.5) for pure black/white. Heavy shake using generic effects: translateX ±8px, translateY ±5px with 0.15s intervals, spring easing for industrial feel. Registration marks: absolutely positioned '+' symbols at corners 'absolute text-2xl font-thin' with same shake offset. Crop marks: border divs 'absolute w-8 h-px bg-black' at edges. Torn edges: clip-path with rough polygon path or mask-image with torn paper PNG. Tape artifacts: semi-transparent divs 'absolute bg-yellow-100/40 backdrop-blur-sm rotate-3' positioned randomly. Slam-in animation: scale from 1.3 to 1 with spring(1, 80, 10, 0) easing over 0.4s, combined with opacity 0 to 1 instantly. Add noise texture overlay 'absolute inset-0 opacity-20 mix-blend-multiply bg-[url(noise)]'. Consider audio-reactive shake intensity using waveform effects if audio present.

prompts.prompt: Design a samizdat underground publication text effect that evokes secretly distributed, hand-duplicated political texts. Imagine text that's been through multiple generations of carbon paper copying - faint in places, doubled in others from carbon paper slip. The shake should suggest hand-cranked duplicator operation - irregular rhythm, varying intensity. Add carbon paper artifacts: blue-purple tinting, reverse text impressions (mirror ghost images), and uneven pressure marks. Include typewriter characteristics - slightly misaligned characters, heavier impression on some letters. Implement paper texture with visible fibers and age spots. The reveal should be character-by-character with irregular timing, as if manually typed under pressure.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-100 to-blue-50'. Main TextAtom 'text-blue-900/80 font-mono text-4xl'. Carbon copy layers: duplicate TextAtom with 'absolute opacity-30 translate-x-1 translate-y-1 text-blue-800'. Ghost impression: mirrored TextAtom 'absolute scale-x-[-1] opacity-10 translate-x-2'. Irregular shake via generic effects with random intervals: Math.random() based translateX/Y (±2-4px) changing every 100-300ms. Character misalignment: split text into individual spans, apply random transforms 'translate-y-[${Math.random() * 2}px] rotate-[${Math.random() * 2 - 1}deg]'. Uneven pressure: vary opacity per character (0.7-1.0 range). Paper texture: overlay div 'absolute inset-0 opacity-30 bg-[url(paper-fibers)] mix-blend-multiply'. Age spots: scattered divs 'absolute w-4 h-4 bg-yellow-800/10 rounded-full blur-md'. Character-by-character reveal using internal effect preset with staggered opacity animations, irregular delays (50-150ms between chars). Add subtle blur variations to simulate focus issues.

prompts.prompt: Develop a destroyed letterpress text effect that looks like printing plates that have been damaged and weathered. Visualize text with deep impression marks, ink pooling in damaged areas, and chunks missing from worn plates. The shake should be minimal but include sudden jolts - like a printing press hitting damaged sections of the plate. Add metal type artifacts: rust stains, scratches, and bent character portions. Include ink rollover effects where too much ink creates dark blobs. Implement paper impression depth with multiple shadow layers suggesting deep letterpress bite. The text should reveal with a mechanical press motion - quick down-and-up movement with brief pause at pressure point.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-amber-50'. TextAtom with deep impression styling 'text-gray-900 font-serif text-6xl font-bold'. Deep bite effect: multiple text-shadows 'text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 3px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'. Damaged sections: use clip-path to remove chunks or overlay divs with matching background to hide parts. Ink pooling: :before elements on specific characters with 'absolute bg-black rounded-full blur-sm' positioned at character corners. Rust stains: overlay divs 'absolute bg-gradient-radial from-orange-800/30 to-transparent blur-md'. Mechanical shake: baseline smooth with sudden jolts - generic effects alternating between small (±1px) and large (±5px) translations. Press motion reveal: animate translateY from -20px to 0 with brief pause, combined with subtle scale from 0.95 to 1. Add texture using filter: url(#roughPaper) or CSS grain. Scratches: thin divs 'absolute h-px bg-gray-400/50 rotate-[various]' crossing through text. Ink blob artifacts at random positions 'absolute w-8 h-6 bg-black/80 rounded-[40%] blur-sm'.

prompts.prompt: Create a paranoid conspiracy theory text effect that looks like heavily redacted, photocopied documents with handwritten annotations. Picture classified documents that have been copied so many times they're barely legible, with black marker redactions, coffee stains, and frantic handwritten notes in margins. The shake should be erratic and nervous - sudden movements suggesting someone hastily copying documents. Add redaction bars that occasionally glitch to reveal text underneath. Include paper clip shadows, staple holes, and fold marks. Implement highlighter marks in yellow and pink with realistic transparency. The text should flicker between visible and redacted states, with some words permanently censored.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-100 to-gray-200 shadow-inner'. Main TextAtom 'text-black/70 font-serif text-base leading-loose'. Redaction bars: divs with 'absolute bg-black h-6' positioned over specific words, with occasional opacity flicker (1 to 0.8) using generic effects. Coffee stains: absolute divs 'w-24 h-24 bg-gradient-radial from-yellow-900/20 via-yellow-800/10 to-transparent rounded-full blur-sm'. Handwritten notes: rotated TextAtoms 'absolute text-blue-800 font-cursive text-sm rotate-[-5deg]' in margins. Highlighter marks: divs with 'absolute bg-yellow-300/40 mix-blend-multiply' behind text sections. Paper artifacts: staple holes 'absolute w-2 h-2 bg-gray-400 rounded-full', fold marks 'absolute h-full w-px bg-gray-300/50'. Erratic shake using generic effects with random, nervous patterns: sudden translateX/Y jumps (±3-7px) with varying intervals (50-500ms). Flicker effect: random opacity changes between words, some permanently at 0 (censored). Glitch reveal: internal effect preset that briefly shows redacted text (opacity 0 to 1 to 0 over 200ms). Add noise and grain overlays for photocopy texture. Use sub-presets for reusable document artifact elements.
